**How to submit:** Upload your WAV file and your answers (a photo of your paper or a document) to the university e-learning platform. Due: **before lecture 15**.

## Task 1 · Your sound effect (3 marks)

Choose one sound for a game: a coin, a door, a jump, a splash, a button
click. Record it with Audacity or a free recorder app.

a) Record three takes with 2 seconds of room tone. Write the settings you
used (sample rate, channels) and the peak level of your best take. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

b) Clean your best take: trim, noise reduction, fade-out, then normalize to
−1 dB. Write the steps you did, in order. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=3 >}}

c) Export it as a WAV, 16-bit, mono, with a good name (for example
`sfx_coin_01.wav`). Upload the file. (1 mark)

## Task 2 · Settings and sizes (2 marks)

a) Your sound lasts 1.5 seconds at 48 kHz, 16-bit, mono. How many bytes is
the WAV file? Show the calculation. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

b) The game also needs a 2-minute background music. Which format do you
choose for it, and why? (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}
